title: a runtime-authored row is never the user speaking
invariant: a runtime notice (a protocol repair, a goal closeout nudge, a child settlement) is model context written by the runtime: it is not a User line, not a Thought, and its provenance survives; user-authored English that happens to carry the same words is still a User line
